sources_read.section: §2.1 bootstrap, §2.2 push (four properties), §2.3 pull (three rules), §2.4 reconcile, §2.5 reconnect order, §2.6 failure matrix

§5.3 F1 (parked op stalls the outbox), F2 (row flag needs three states), F3 (unpaginated manifest deletes rows), F5 (burst applied in one transaction), F7 (remote delete has only old_record), F8 (manifest per client-written table)
§6.4 the sync engine as listener middleware
broadcast triggers: ws:{sessionId} public rows, user:{profileId} private rows, RETRACT, NULL-topic guard (F4)
existing kernel: applyRemote(event, myProfileId) with F7/RETRACT handled, writeRow, OutboxOp state queued|failed, _sync clean|pending|failed
listeners: sync listens on workspaceOpened, outboxQueued, modeChanged, remoteChangeReceived

scope: The sync engine: outbox push, coalesce and backoff, realtime channel, manifest reconcile and paginated bootstrap, the sync slice and selectors, the listener middleware, the sync-status-pill, the meta pull of non-mirrored tables, and moving 008's direct writes (transfer, personas) and its one-shot pull onto the engine. Out of scope: presence/cursors (015, live: topic), the mode-switch UI and export (016), the create-workspace command endpoint (017), the OPFS blob channel, feature UIs, and any supabase-js import outside shared/lib/supabase.ts and realtime/channel.ts (I21).

acceptance_criteria.text: A parked op never stalls the ops queued behind it; ops behind a parked parent park with it.
At most one pending update per row; a 403 parks once and surfaces (row _sync = failed); a 503 or network error retries with backoff.
setAuth() runs before subscribe and after every token refresh; 40 events in a burst cause one Dexie transaction; a remote delete and a RETRACT land.
Reconnect runs push, then pull, then resubscribe; a manifest that hits the page cap deletes nothing; highlights and notes each have a paginated manifest; an interrupted bootstrap resumes.
Every sync step is a dispatched action; the listener is prepended once in store.ts; the sync slice is whitelisted and its ui stripped.

Each listed behaviour has a failing-then-passing test (seq order, coalescing, 4xx parking, failed-head skip, reconnect order, delete detection, capped manifest, paginated bootstrap resume) and test totals > 0.
Teams, roster, personas and the session row reach Dexie meta through the engine; no component reads them over the network; transfer and persona saves are outbox ops.

risks: One of the two tasks most likely to overrun (tasks §4): timebox g1-g4, then report.
Honest size is 800-1200 lines with tests (split §5.1).
Missing setAuth() after a token refresh stops delivery silently about an hour in (I22): a test refreshes the token and asserts events still arrive.
Pull before push overwrites unsent local rows (RULE-13): the reconnect order is a listener test.

Realtime broadcast needs the Lite stack's realtime service and private-channel authorization; if the local stack does not deliver, the two-browser gate cannot run and that is reported, not worked around.
Replacing 008's pull and pill can break the working shell: re-run 008's gate test and Chrome pass after the swap.
